## 2024-05-18 - Unbounded State Arrays and Random Assignment DoS
**Vulnerability:** Unbounded arrays from user input combined with bounded `do...while` loops for unique random assignment.
**Learning:** If users can add an unlimited number of items (like players) and the application assigns unique random numbers from a fixed range (e.g., 1 to 100), exceeding the range causes an infinite loop in the `do...while` structure. Unbounded arrays also cause memory exhaustion and excessive DOM rendering.
**Prevention:** Always enforce constraints on arrays generated by user input. Use maximum limits (e.g., 20 players) and maximum lengths on text inputs (e.g., `maxLength={30}`) to prevent DoS attacks.
